summary: Brood Rush balance re-tunes trailVolume.Value on 12 vessel prefabs' prism controllers (Orca, Sparrow, Wrasse, Scarab, Honeyguide, Squirrel, Stoat, Meerkat, Dolphin, Urchin, TigerMoth, Thresher) via Tools/Build/brood_trail_levers.py; your unmerged Charles-Land branch edits the same prefab files, so expect a one-line merge conflict per prefab.
